selection_rule: Candidates compared to all inherited and newly extracted 30-day lesson fingerprints. Rejected URL-new candidates when mechanism/workflow was substantially equivalent. Primary sources are Fortinet documentation; Community sources are scenario-only.

topics.lesson_subject: BGP neighbor transport establishment: interpreting Active state and debug error 107
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: BGP peer TCP/179 transport establishment; Idle-Connect-Active-Established state machine; update-source, multihop, and password dependencies
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: route lookup to peer -> TCP SYN/SYN-ACK/ACK -> BGP OPEN/capability negotiation -> KEEPALIVE -> Established
topics.failure_class: transport handshake incomplete before BGP OPEN; routing, asymmetry, port filtering, peer identity, authentication, or IPsec selector fault
topics.evidence_pattern: get router info routing-table all; get router info bgp neighbors <peer>; debug message 107; packet capture shows missing SYN-ACK or incomplete TCP 3-way handshake; error 104 indicates reset
topics.remediation_path: restore route and symmetric return path; permit TCP/179; correct peer address/AS/update-source/multihop/password; verify IPsec Phase 2 selectors; only inspect route-policy after Established
topics.question_fingerprint: distinguish BGP transport state from OPEN/UPDATE policy state using Active and error 107
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: linear state machine with parallel failure branches at route lookup, TCP handshake, and BGP OPEN
topics.uniqueness_check: Distinct from prior BFD/GR, EVPN, overlay BGP, route-map, and ADVPN lessons: this teaches pre-OPEN TCP transport failure.

topics.lesson_subject: FortiManager install-time platform capability mismatch for udp-not-quic in SSL/SSH profiles
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: FortiManager install validation and target-specific CLI capability; FortiOS ssl-ssh-profile https/dot udp-not-quic action for non-QUIC UDP
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: ADOM package/device DB -> target selection -> validation -> install preview -> CLI payload -> target parser/hardware capability check -> commit or reject
topics.failure_class: target model/firmware does not expose the CLI option generated by the manager; install fails despite a valid manager-side object
topics.evidence_pattern: install validation report and task log; target model/RAM/FortiOS build; preview contains udp-not-quic under https and dot; device CLI returns unsupported object/operation
topics.remediation_path: scope the profile by supported model/build; use a supported value or unset the unsupported field in both https and dot; re-preview per target; upgrade only when the documented fixed build is available
topics.question_fingerprint: distinguish manager-side validation/preview from actual target parser and hardware support
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: fan-out from one FortiManager package to multiple hardware targets with one rejected low-memory branch
topics.uniqueness_check: Distinct from prior ADOM revisions, object deletion, device licensing, policy install, and template lessons: focuses on CLI schema/hardware capability mismatch.

topics.lesson_subject: Fluentd Azure Monitor Log Ingestion output profiles with variable-based secret masking
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Fluentd Azure Logs Ingestion output plugin; App Registration, DCE, DCR, custom _CL table, TimeGenerated transform, and ${VARIABLE} indirection
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: FortiAnalyzer log -> output profile -> variable substitution -> Azure identity/token -> DCE/DCR -> custom Log Analytics table
topics.failure_class: forwarding profile validates locally but remote ingestion rejects schema, identity, endpoint, DCR, table, or secret configuration
topics.evidence_pattern: Validate and Save result; selected Output Profile on Remote Server; Azure DCR/table data; TimeGenerated transformation; Fluentd variable values not literal secrets
topics.remediation_path: create App Registration and Monitoring Metrics Publisher role; verify six required variables; use _CL table and TimeGenerated transform; attach profile to Remote Server forwarding
topics.question_fingerprint: separate output-profile definition from remote-server attachment and Azure ingestion acceptance
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: two-plane pipeline: FortiAnalyzer profile/remote-server chain feeding Azure identity, DCE, DCR and custom table
topics.uniqueness_check: Distinct from prior log forwarding, OFTP, log fetching, retention, and cloud offload lessons.

topics.lesson_subject: VRRP master election driven by destination-route tracking
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: VRRP virtual IP/virtual MAC plus vrdst route reachability tracking; tracked destination loss drives priority to zero and backup takeover
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: master advertises VIP/VMAC -> local route to vrdst is evaluated -> priority changes on reachability loss -> backup becomes master -> gratuitous ARP/VMAC forwarding resumes
topics.failure_class: master remains alive at interface level but loses upstream route to critical destination, so ordinary VRRP advertisements alone would preserve a black-holed gateway
topics.evidence_pattern: get router info vrrp shows MASTER/BACKUP, priority and vrdst; route table and ping to tracked destination; packet capture of advertisements and gateway MAC movement
topics.remediation_path: set vrdst to a meaningful routed destination; align VRID/VIP/VMAC and preemption; validate both paths and model limitations; avoid tracking an endpoint unreachable from both switches
topics.question_fingerprint: distinguish link-state failover from route-reachability failover using vrdst and priority 0
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: dual-switch active/standby topology with shared VIP/VMAC and a separate tracked upstream destination
topics.uniqueness_check: No previous FortiSwitch lesson taught VRRP route tracking; prior switch topics cover EVPN, STP, ACL, LLDP, PoE, and storm control.

topics.lesson_subject: IPv6 CAPWAP management: AP discovery, DHCPv6 Option 52, and NPU offload boundary
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: IPv6 AP-controller discovery by multicast or DHCPv6 Option 52; CAPWAP control/data over IPv6; NP7/NP7lite offload eligibility
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: FortiAP IPv6 link -> AC discovery multicast/DHCPv6 -> FortiGate fabric-accessible IPv6 interface -> CAPWAP control/data -> SSID and firmware management
topics.failure_class: AP cannot discover or sustain IPv6 controller channel because of interface access, multicast/RA/DHCPv6, routing, or unsupported offload assumptions
topics.evidence_pattern: IPv6 interface address and ip6-allowaccess fabric; discovery-mc-addr6; DHCPv6 option 52; UDP 5246/5247 capture; NP7/NP7lite versus NP6 platform
topics.remediation_path: enable IPv6 fabric access; configure multicast or Option 52; verify routed IPv6 reachability and UDP CAPWAP; do not expect NP6/NP6lite CAPWAP offload
topics.question_fingerprint: distinguish IPv6 AP management reachability from client IPv6 service and from NPU offload capability
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: dual discovery branches (multicast and DHCPv6) converging on AC, then CAPWAP control/data channels and hardware offload gate
topics.uniqueness_check: Distinct from prior mesh, RadSec, MLO, AP balancing, EST/SCEP, and CAPWAP stability topics. Adjacent CAPWAP forum post is not claimed as an IPv6-specific scenario.

topics.lesson_subject: RADIUS-only network-device integration using server, response-attribute, and logical VLAN selectors
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: RADIUS-only NAS integration without SNMP/CLI; three selector engines choose RADIUS server, response attributes, and logical VLAN mapping
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: NAS Access-Request -> device identification -> RADIUS Server Selector -> local/proxy auth -> state/policy -> Response Attribute Selector -> VLAN Mapping Selector -> Access-Accept
topics.failure_class: request authenticates but wrong/default VLAN is returned because selector, policy membership, registration, or attribute mapping is incomplete
topics.evidence_pattern: RADIUS logs show NAS-IP, Calling-Station-Id, selector rule matches, selected local/proxy config, matched logical network, Tunnel-Type, Tunnel-Medium-Type, Tunnel-Private-Group-Id
topics.remediation_path: match all three selectors; create logical networks/VLAN map; ensure host registration and state-based access policy where dynamic enforcement is needed; verify shared secret and NAS identity
topics.question_fingerprint: identify why an Access-Accept returns Default VLAN even when host is registered and policy appears to match
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: RADIUS request path through three parallel selector gates into a response attribute builder
topics.uniqueness_check: Distinct from prior L2/L3 polling, traps, CoA, portal, and first-match network-access policy lessons; RADIUS-only NAS integration has no SNMP/CLI control plane.

topics.lesson_subject: Security Actions authorization boundary: license entitlement versus administrator-profile permissions
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: Security Actions API authorization requires both licensed feature entitlement and Admin Profile Add/Modify permissions; Security Incident/ATR and Endpoint Compliance contexts differ
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: administrator creates action -> UI POST /actions/policy/event-action/ -> license feature gate -> profile permission gate -> persist action or return HTTP 403
topics.failure_class: HTTP 403 on save despite broad profile permissions because requested action context is not licensed, or profile changes have not been re-authenticated
topics.evidence_pattern: browser network request POST /actions/policy/event-action/ returns 403; license management page; Admin Profile Security Actions permissions; action context is Security Incidents versus Endpoint Compliance
topics.remediation_path: identify action context; verify PLUS/PRO entitlement as documented for that context; verify Access/Add-Modify on assigned profile; log out/in after profile change; save a test action
topics.question_fingerprint: distinguish entitlement denial from missing profile permission using HTTP 403 and action context
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: authorization decision with two independent gates (license and profile) before action persistence
topics.uniqueness_check: Distinct from prior NAC policy, host containment, event forwarding, and RADIUS proxy lessons; focuses on management-plane entitlement and permission gates.

topics.lesson_subject: TACACS+ client-policy binding, authorization rules, and authorization-before-authentication interoperability
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: TACACS+ client registration and policy selection; authentication followed by user/group authorization rules for shell and non-shell services
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: network-device TACACS+ request -> client match -> policy/authentication -> authorization session -> command/service rule evaluation -> permit/deny response
topics.failure_class: client/server sequence incompatibility when NAS sends authorization before authentication; unsupported challenge-response or stale authorization session
topics.evidence_pattern: FAC debug page /debug/ TACACS+ service; client matched policy; authentication event; authorization rule; default 28,800-second session; no challenge-response support
topics.remediation_path: verify client registration and policy; confirm client request order; align device to supported auth-then-authorize flow; append token to password for 2FA; tune session duration if required
topics.question_fingerprint: recognize that an authorization-first TACACS+ client cannot be fixed by changing a command authorization rule
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: two-phase TACACS+ sequence with a client registration/policy gate and separate authentication and authorization branches
topics.uniqueness_check: Distinct from prior FAC RADIUS policy selection, OAuth PKCE, FIDO2, SAML, and RADIUS attributes; TACACS+ command authorization is a different protocol and transaction.

topics.lesson_subject: ZTNA-protected FortiPAM REST API access with client certificate, EMS posture, and bearer token
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: FortiPAM access-proxy client certificate validation plus EMS ZTNA posture tag and API-user bearer token
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: FortiClient endpoint connects to EMS -> posture tag/certificate -> access proxy validates client cert -> user/API authentication -> /pam API gateway route -> secret-level authorization
topics.failure_class: TLS client-certificate failure, missing EMS tag, API token failure, or access/secret-level ZTNA policy mismatch
topics.evidence_pattern: curl client certificate thumbprint/PKCS#11 key; Authorization: Bearer token; access-proxy client-cert setting; EMS tag; API response; certificate validation log
topics.remediation_path: verify cert chain/private key and client cert presentation; verify EMS tag and access-proxy rule; verify API token/user scope; separate FortiPAM tunnel/API route from on-prem tunnel
topics.question_fingerprint: distinguish device trust (certificate/tag) from API identity (bearer token)
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: endpoint-to-EMS control channel and endpoint-to-FortiPAM mTLS/API data channel with dual authorization gates
topics.uniqueness_check: Distinct from prior secret checkout, TOTP, native launcher, scheduled jobs, recording, and discovery lessons.

topics.lesson_subject: Offline FortiSIEM OS repository synchronization and component-specific upgrade sequence
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: version-matched FortiSIEM OS package repository mirrored by fsm-sync-os-repo.sh and consumed by Supervisor/Manager/Worker/Collector upgrade workflows
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: internet staging host -> target-version upgrade ZIP/script -> 2TB repo sync -> NFS/USB mount -> Supervisor upgrade -> Worker password/repo -> Collector image-server workflow
topics.failure_class: incomplete or wrong-version OS repository, missing mount after reboot, insufficient disk, wrong script source, or Collector hash-check mismatch
topics.evidence_pattern: df -h >= 2TB for 7.5.1; script version; wget process completion; mount/fstab; upgrade.sh --offline-osrepo-path; Supervisor/Worker/Collector version and logs
topics.remediation_path: extract script from target upgrade ZIP when required; sync full repo; verify space and files; mount persistently; upgrade Supervisor before Workers; apply documented Collector image-server setting
topics.question_fingerprint: identify why an offline upgrade still reaches the Internet or fails after Supervisor upgrade
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: staging repository fan-out to Supervisor, Worker, and Collector with ordered dependency arrows
topics.uniqueness_check: Distinct from prior SIEM rule execution, ClickHouse, CMDB, synthetic monitoring, and event semantics.

topics.lesson_subject: FortiClient Multi-Connect boundary: concurrent IKEv2 tunnels, DNS priority, and SASE-managed tunnel ownership
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: FortiClient beta Multi-Connect for concurrent IPsec IKEv2 tunnels; DNS-priority ordering maps to Windows tunnel interface metric; FortiSASE owns its service tunnel Phase1/Phase2
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: FortiSASE telemetry pushes endpoint profile -> FortiClient establishes SASE data tunnel and eligible on-prem IKEv2 tunnel -> Windows DNS chooses tunnel by priority/metric
topics.failure_class: attempt to edit service-owned SASE Phase1/Phase2, unsupported client/platform/release, second tunnel failure, or DNS queries routed through wrong tunnel
topics.evidence_pattern: endpoint profile Multi-Connect enabled; eligible IPsec IKEv2 tunnels; per-tunnel state; Windows interface metrics and DNS server order; FortiSASE telemetry/control channel versus IPsec data channel
topics.remediation_path: confirm exact FortiSASE/FortiClient feature matrix and beta status; do not edit SASE Phase1/Phase2; configure the on-prem tunnel through supported profile controls; set DNS priority; test each tunnel independently
topics.question_fingerprint: distinguish SASE-managed tunnel negotiation from endpoint-managed custom tunnel and DNS priority
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: two parallel IKEv2 tunnels (SASE and on-prem) controlled by a telemetry profile, converging at Windows DNS-priority decision
topics.uniqueness_check: Distinct from prior FortiSASE Branch On-ramp site-to-site IKEv2/BGP: this is endpoint-side concurrent remote-access tunnels and DNS metric ordering.

topics.lesson_subject: Monthly traffic-volume quota steering with billing-cycle reset and member preference adjustment
topics.feature_mechanism_fingerprint: per-member quota-limit and billing-start-day; overage triggers in-memory cost/weight/volume-ratio adjustment used by SD-WAN member selection
topics.workflow_transaction_fingerprint: member byte counter accumulates -> billing period threshold crossed -> overage preference values applied -> SLA-mode service reselects path -> billing day resets counters and preference
topics.failure_class: unexpected expensive underlay use because quota threshold/period is misconfigured, overage is disabled, or SLA/service rules exclude the alternative
topics.evidence_pattern: diagnose sys sdwan bill member <id>; diagnose sys sdwan service4/service6; used bytes since billing day; overaged state; member alive/SLA and selected flags
topics.remediation_path: set quota-limit, billing-start-day and overage values; verify alternative member is alive and eligible in service rule; validate counter and next reset day; confirm HA behavior
topics.question_fingerprint: distinguish volume quota overage from SLA failure and physical link-down
topics.diagram_topology_layout_fingerprint: member usage counter and billing-cycle gate feeding dynamic cost/weight values into SLA member selection, with monthly reset loop
topics.uniqueness_check: Distinct from prior SD-WAN SLA failover, packet duplication, ADVPN, DSCP, branch on-ramp, and interface migration lessons.
